entities.name: Client Devices
entities.rationale: Client mobile and web devices requesting and streaming the personalized videos.

entities.name: CloudFront
entities.rationale: CloudFront CDN used to deliver personalized video segments efficiently to the client devices.

entities.name: API Gateway
entities.rationale: API Gateway serving as the frontend entry point managing usage plans and API keys to control load.

entities.name: RAS Frontend Lambda
entities.rationale: Lambda function serving as the RAS frontend to validate rendering requests and manage SQS workflows.

entities.name: SQS Jobs Queue
entities.rationale: SQS queue storing rendering tasks and instructions for the rendering engine.

entities.name: SQS Responses Queue
entities.rationale: SQS queue holding status responses and playlist links that the frontend pulls from.

entities.name: Rendering EC2 Instances
entities.rationale: EC2 Spot instances used to render video segments under the Auto Scaling group. Visually grouped inside the EC2 Auto Scaling box.

entities.name: Auto Scaling Group
entities.rationale: Auto Scaling group managing the pool of rendering spot instances. Visually grouped inside the EC2 Auto Scaling box.

entities.name: S3 Bucket
entities.rationale: S3 bucket storing the rendered personalized video segments.

entities.name: Step Functions
entities.rationale: Step Functions used to trigger the custom scaling Lambda function every 15 seconds.

entities.name: Scaling Lambda
entities.rationale: Lambda function evaluating capacity based on CloudWatch metrics and instructing the Auto Scaling group to scale.

entities.name: CloudWatch
entities.rationale: CloudWatch collecting performance metrics and dispatching spot instance interruption events.

entities.name: Interruption Handler Lambda
entities.rationale: Lambda function reacting to Spot Interruption Events to safely drain and detach instances from the Auto Scaling Group.

visual_connections.description: Users request monthly video bill through API Gateway.
API Gateway routes requests to frontend validation Lambda.
Lambda pushes rendering instructions to SQS queue.
EC2 spot instances pull jobs from SQS when they have capacity.
Engine immediately responds back to the response SQS queue.
Frontend Lambda polls SQS for the playlist information.
Provides the playlist file link back to the player on the client device.
EC2 rendering engine uploads finished video segments to S3.
Client device requests video playback through CloudFront.
CloudFront pulls video segments from the S3 origin.
CloudWatch Events triggers Lambda on spot interruption notice.
Lambda calls API on EC2 to stop pulling new jobs and drain current ones.
Lambda detaches the interrupted instance from the ASG.
Step Functions trigger the custom scaling calculation every 15 seconds.
Scaling Lambda instructs ASG to scale up or down based on metrics.
Rendering instances publish custom performance metrics to CloudWatch.
